fields.DESC_RECIPE_WORKBENCH:
<mapObjectName id=|WorkBench|/> for producing simple items.
Pals with <uiCommon id=|COMMON_WORK_SUITABILITY_Handcraft|/> suitability help
speed up production.
fields.DESC_RECIPE_AXE1:
An axe for cutting wood.
Made from stone, it's not very sharp.
fields.DESC_RECIPE_AXE2:
An axe for cutting wood.
Made from metal, its sharpness has improved.
Requires <mapObjectName id=|Factory_Hard_01|/> to craft.
fields.DESC_RECIPE_AXE3:
An axe for cutting wood.
Made from high quality metal, its sharpness has improved even further.
Requires <mapObjectName id=|Factory_Hard_02|/> to craft.
fields.DESC_RECIPE_PICKEAXE1:
A pickaxe used for mining.
Made from stone, the efficiency is questionable.
fields.DESC_RECIPE_PICKEAXE2:
A pickaxe used for mining.
Made from metal, its durability and efficiency have improved.
Requires <mapObjectName id=|Factory_Hard_01|/> to craft.
fields.DESC_RECIPE_PICKEAXE3:
A pickaxe used for mining.
Its durability and efficiency have further improved.
Requires <mapObjectName id=|Factory_Hard_02|/> to craft.
fields.DESC_RECIPE_IRON_INGOT: Uses <itemName id=|CopperOre|/> and <itemName id=|Coal|/> to produce <itemName id=|IronIngot|/>s.
fields.DESC_RECIPE_BAT:
A <itemName id=|Bat|/> for close range combat.
Can beat a small Pal to a pulp if need be.
fields.DESC_RECIPE_ELECBATON:
Close range weapon that sends out an electric jolt upon contact.
Pals are easier to capture when electrocuted.
Requires <mapObjectName id=|Factory_Hard_01|/> to craft.
fields.DESC_RECIPE_BOW3:
An enhanced bow that allows three arrows to be fired simultaneously.
By some strange mechanism, it only consumes a single <itemName id=|Arrow|/> when fired.
fields.DESC_RECIPE_BOW:
Primitive long range weapon.
Requires <mapObjectName id=|WorkBench|/> to craft.
fields.DESC_RECIPE_BOW_FIRE:
A bow that deals <uiCommon id=|COMMON_ELEMENT_NAME_Fire|/> damage.
Burns Pals with fire arrows, making them easier to capture.
Requires <itemName id=|Arrow_Fire|/>.
fields.DESC_RECIPE_BOW_POISON:
Frightening bow that poisons its target.
Poisoned Pals are easier to capture.
Requires <itemName id=|Arrow_Poison|/>.
fields.DESC_RECIPE_BOWGUN_FIRE:
A <itemName id=|BowGun|/> that deals <uiCommon id=|COMMON_ELEMENT_NAME_Fire|/> damage.
Requires <itemName id=|Arrow_Fire|/>.
Requires <mapObjectName id=|WeaponFactory_Dirty_01|/> to craft.
fields.DESC_RECIPE_BOWGUN_POISON:
A <itemName id=|BowGun|/> that inflicts poison on its target.
Requires <itemName id=|Arrow_Poison|/>.
Requires <mapObjectName id=|WeaponFactory_Dirty_01|/> to craft.
fields.DESC_RECIPE_ARROW:
Used with <itemName id=|WeakerBow|/>.
Requires <mapObjectName id=|WorkBench|/> to craft.
fields.DESC_RECIPE_ARROW_FIRE:
<itemName id=|Arrow|/>s for shooting with <itemName id=|Bow_Fire|/> and <itemName id=|BowGun_Fire|/>.
Deals <uiCommon id=|COMMON_ELEMENT_NAME_Fire|/> damage.
Requires <mapObjectName id=|WorkBench|/> to craft.
fields.DESC_RECIPE_ARROW_POISON:
<itemName id=|Arrow|/>s for shooting with <itemName id=|Bow_Poison|/> and <itemName id=|BowGun_Poison|/>.
It poisons any target it hits.
Requires <mapObjectName id=|WorkBench|/> to craft.
fields.DESC_RECIPE_WEAPONFACTRY:
Produces simple mechanical weapons.
Requires Pal with <uiCommon id=|COMMON_WORK_SUITABILITY_Handcraft|/> suitability.
fields.DESC_RECIPE_HUNDGUN:
A handgun with improved capacity and rapid-fire capabilities.
Has more immediate firepower than a <itemName id=|MakeshiftHandgun|/>.
Crafted at <mapObjectName id=|WeaponFactory_Dirty_01|/>.
fields.DESC_RECIPE_RIFLE:
A single-shot rifle. Takes time to load.
What it lacks in capacity, it makes up for with sheer power.
Crafted at <mapObjectName id=|WeaponFactory_Dirty_02|/>.
fields.DESC_RECIPE_RIFLEBULLET:
Ammo for <itemName id=|SingleShotRifle|/> and other similar weapons.
Requires <mapObjectName id=|WeaponFactory_Dirty_01|/> to craft.
fields.DESC_RECIPE_SHOTGUN:
Wreaks havoc at close range. Can fire twice before reloading.
Despite the limited load capacity, it still packs a punch.
Crafted at <mapObjectName id=|WeaponFactory_Dirty_02|/>.
fields.DESC_RECIPE_SHOTGUNBULLET:
Ammo for shotguns and other similar weapons.
Requires <mapObjectName id=|WeaponFactory_Dirty_01|/> to craft.
fields.DESC_RECIPE_ARMOR1:
Protects against cold nights.
Requires <mapObjectName id=|WorkBench|/> to craft.
fields.DESC_RECIPE_ARMOR1_Heat:
<itemName id=|ClothArmor|/> produced in hot regions.
Boasts high heat resistance.
Requires <mapObjectName id=|WorkBench|/> to craft.
fields.DESC_RECIPE_ARMOR1_Cold:
<itemName id=|ClothArmor|/> produced in cold regions.
Useful for surviving in cold climates.
Requires <mapObjectName id=|WorkBench|/> to craft.
fields.DESC_RECIPE_ARMOR2:
Armor made from <itemName id=|Leather|/>.
Its warmth and defense have been improved.
Requires <mapObjectName id=|Factory_Hard_01|/> to craft.
fields.DESC_RECIPE_ARMOR2_Heat:
<itemName id=|FurArmor|/> produced in hot regions.
Boasts high heat resistance.
Requires <mapObjectName id=|Factory_Hard_01|/> to craft.
fields.DESC_RECIPE_ARMOR2_Cold:
<itemName id=|FurArmor|/> produced in cold regions.
Useful for surviving in cold climates.
Requires <mapObjectName id=|Factory_Hard_01|/> to craft.
fields.DESC_RECIPE_ARMOR3:
Armor made of metal.
Somewhat heavy, but provides good defense.
Requires <mapObjectName id=|Factory_Hard_01|/> to craft.
fields.DESC_RECIPE_ARMOR3_Heat:
Improved <itemName id=|CopperArmor|/>.
Boasts high heat resistance.
Requires <mapObjectName id=|Factory_Hard_01|/> to craft.
fields.DESC_RECIPE_ARMOR3_Cold:
Improved <itemName id=|CopperArmor|/>.
Useful for surviving in cold climates.
Requires <mapObjectName id=|Factory_Hard_01|/> to craft.
fields.DESC_RECIPE_ARMOR4:
Armor made from high quality metal.
Quite heavy, but provides excellent defense.
Requires <mapObjectName id=|Factory_Hard_02|/> to craft.
fields.DESC_RECIPE_ARMOR4_Cold:
Improved <itemName id=|IronArmor|/>.
Useful for surviving in cold climates.
Requires <mapObjectName id=|Factory_Hard_02|/> to craft.
fields.DESC_RECIPE_ARMOR4_Heat:
Improved <itemName id=|IronArmor|/>.
Boasts high heat resistance.
Requires <mapObjectName id=|Factory_Hard_02|/> to craft.
fields.DESC_RECIPE_ARMOR5:
Armor fully utilizing the latest technology.
Boasts overwhelming defense.
Requires <mapObjectName id=|Factory_Hard_03|/> to craft.
fields.DESC_RECIPE_ARMOR5_Heat:
Improved <itemName id=|StealArmor|/>.
Boasts high heat resistance.
Requires <mapObjectName id=|Factory_Hard_03|/> to craft.
fields.DESC_RECIPE_ARMOR5_Cold:
Improved <itemName id=|StealArmor|/>.
Useful for surviving in cold climates.
Requires <mapObjectName id=|Factory_Hard_03|/> to craft.
fields.DESC_RECIPE_HELMET2:
A beautiful feathered headband.
Though improbable, it somehow protects its wearer from lethal head injuries.
Requires <mapObjectName id=|Workbench|/> to craft.
fields.DESC_RECIPE_HELMET3:
A helm made of metal.
A reliable piece of armor that protects your head, and all the thoughts within.
Requires <mapObjectName id=|Factory_Hard_01|/> to craft.
fields.DESC_RECIPE_HELMET4:
A helm made from high quality metal.
Its sheen gives the wearer a greater sense of confidence.
Requires <mapObjectName id=|Factory_Hard_02|/> to craft.
fields.DESC_RECIPE_HELMET5:
A helm made from <itemName id=|StealIngot|/>.
Envied for its immaculate quality, it is proof of a chosen warrior.
Requires <mapObjectName id=|Factory_Hard_03|/> to craft.
fields.DESC_RECIPE_CAMPFIRE:
Used to make simple food
or provide meager warmth and light.
fields.DESC_RECIPE_COOKINGSTOVE: Can efficiently prepare more varieties of foods.
fields.DESC_RECIPE_PALBED:
Pals at base recover SAN when sleeping in beds at night.
Without a bed, Pals cannot sleep soundly, and no SAN is recovered.
fields.DESC_RECIPE_PALLABO:
Combines several Pals of the same type
to create a higher-ranked version.
fields.DESC_RECIPE_CLOTH:
<itemName id=|Cloth|/> woven from <itemName id=|Wool|/>.
Required to create armor.
fields.DESC_RECIPE_CLOTH2:
Woven from large amounts of <itemName id=|Wool|/>.
Required to create high quality armor.
Can be made at <mapObjectName id=|Factory_Hard_01|/>.
fields.DESC_RECIPE_SPHERE1:
An item that captures Pals when thrown.
This basic model is only effective on low level Pals.
fields.DESC_RECIPE_SPHERE2:
An item that captures Pals when thrown.
Its capabilities have been improved, allowing it to catch a wider range of Pals.
Requires <mapObjectName id=|SphereFactory_Black_01|/> to craft.
fields.DESC_RECIPE_SPHERE3:
An item that captures Pals when thrown.
Able to capture moderately powerful Pals.
Requires <mapObjectName id=|SphereFactory_Black_01|/> to craft.
fields.DESC_RECIPE_SPHERE4:
An item that captures Pals when thrown.
Enhanced capabilities allow it to capture even more powerful Pals.
Requires <mapObjectName id=|SphereFactory_Black_02|/> to craft.
fields.DESC_RECIPE_SPHERE5:
An item that captures Pals when thrown.
Not many Pals can escape its highly efficient design.
Requires <mapObjectName id=|SphereFactory_Black_03|/> to craft.
fields.DESC_RECIPE_SPHERE6:
An item that captures Pals when thrown.
Very few Pals can escape its perfected design.
Requires <mapObjectName id=|SphereFactory_Black_03|/> to craft.
fields.DESC_RECIPE_DefenseWait: Pals assigned to it will watch for approaching enemies.
fields.DESC_RECIPE_DEFENCE_MACHINE_GUN: Assign a Pal with <uiCommon id=|COMMON_WORK_SUITABILITY_Handcraft|/> suitability and it will protect a base using the machine gun.
fields.DESC_RECIPE_SPHERE_FACTORY_BLACK_01:
Produces Spheres for capturing Pals.
Requires Pal with <uiCommon id=|COMMON_WORK_SUITABILITY_Handcraft|/> suitability.
fields.DESC_RECIPE_SHOTGUN2:
A high capacity, powerful shotgun.
It has outstanding close range DPS.
Crafted at <mapObjectName id=|WeaponFactory_Dirty_02|/>.
fields.DESC_RECIPE_ROCKET_LAUNCHER:
A <itemName id=|Launcher_Default|/> 
that can fire a powerful round from long distances.
Requires <mapObjectName id=|WeaponFactory_Dirty_03|/> to craft.
fields.DESC_RECIPE_LAUNCHERBULLET:
Ammo for the <itemName id=|Launcher_Default|/> and other similar weapons.
Requires <mapObjectName id=|WeaponFactory_Dirty_03|/> to craft.
fields.DESC_RECIPE_SPHERE_LAUNCHER:
Innovative launcher that fires many Spheres simultaneously.
Can easily capture a herd of Pals.
Requires <mapObjectName id=|WeaponFactory_Dirty_02|/> to craft.
fields.DESC_RECIPE_SPHERE_LAUNCHER_ONCE:
Can capture distant Pals.
Requires <mapObjectName id=|WeaponFactory_Dirty_01|/> to craft.
fields.DESC_RECIPE_HOMING_SPHERE_LAUNCHER:
Fires Pal Spheres that automatically home in on Pals.
Requires <mapObjectName id=|WeaponFactory_Dirty_03|/> to craft.
fields.DESC_RECIPE_BOWGUN:
Fires an <itemName id=|Arrow|/> effortlessly.
Though it takes time to load, it delivers a powerful shot.
Requires <mapObjectName id=|Factory_Hard_01|/> to craft.
fields.DESC_RECIPE_SWORD:
<itemName id=|Sword|/> for close-range combat.
The blade is extremely sharp! Mightier than a pen, for sure.
Requires <mapObjectName id=|WeaponFactory_Dirty_01|/> to craft.
fields.DESC_RECIPE_ASSAULTRIFLE:
Mows down enemies with overwhelming force.
It excels at rapid-fire and is well suited to taking down powerful foes.
Crafted at <mapObjectName id=|WeaponFactory_Dirty_02|/>.
fields.DESC_RECIPE_MachineParts2:
<itemName id=|MachineParts2|/> required to create precision equipment.
Can be made at <mapObjectName id=|Factory_Hard_02|/>.
fields.DESC_RECIPE_Gunpowder2:
<itemName id=|Gunpowder2|/> used to fire ammunition.
Required to make bullets.
Can be made at <mapObjectName id=|Factory_Hard_01|/>.
fields.DESC_RECIPE_StonePit:
Can produce stone at a base.
Requires Pal with <uiCommon id=|COMMON_WORK_SUITABILITY_Mining|/> suitability.
fields.DESC_RECIPE_SPHERE_FACTORY_BLACK_02:
Creates <itemName id=|PalSphere|/>s at a faster pace.
Requires Pal with <uiCommon id=|COMMON_WORK_SUITABILITY_Handcraft|/> suitability.
fields.DESC_RECIPE_SPHERE_FACTORY_BLACK_03:
Creates <itemName id=|PalSphere|/>s at an even faster pace.
Requires Pal with <uiCommon id=|COMMON_WORK_SUITABILITY_Handcraft|/> suitability.
fields.DESC_RECIPE_COOKING_ELECTRIC_KITCHEN:
Needs electricity but can prepare high-quality food more efficiently.
Requires Pal with <uiCommon id=|COMMON_WORK_SUITABILITY_EmitFlame|/> suitability.
fields.DESC_RECIPE_MEDICAL_PALBED_02: Pals sleep more soundly, improving the amount of Health and SAN recovered while sleeping.
fields.DESC_RECIPE_DEFENCE_GATLING_GUN: Assign a Pal with <uiCommon id=|COMMON_WORK_SUITABILITY_Handcraft|/> suitability and it will protect a base using the gatling gun.
fields.DESC_RECIPE_DEFENCE_MISSILE: Assign a Pal with <uiCommon id=|COMMON_WORK_SUITABILITY_Handcraft|/> suitability and it will protect a base using the missile launcher.
fields.DESC_RECIPE_DEFENCE_BOWGUN: Assign a Pal with <uiCommon id=|COMMON_WORK_SUITABILITY_Handcraft|/> suitability and it will protect a base using the crossbow.
fields.DESC_RECIPE_MEDICINE_FACILITY_01:
Can produce simple medicine.
Requires Pal with <uiCommon id=|COMMON_WORK_SUITABILITY_ProductMedicine|/> trait.
fields.DESC_RECIPE_MEDICINE_FACILITY_02:
Needs electricity but can produce higher-quality medicine.
Requires Pal with <uiCommon id=|COMMON_WORK_SUITABILITY_ProductMedicine|/> trait.
fields.DESC_RECIPE_WEAPON_FACTORY_DIRTY_02:
Needs electricity but produces weapons and ammunition at a faster pace.
Requires Pal with <uiCommon id=|COMMON_WORK_SUITABILITY_Handcraft|/> trait.
fields.DESC_RECIPE_WEAPON_FACTORY_DIRTY_03:
Needs electricity but produces weapons and ammunition at an even faster pace.
Requires Pal with <uiCommon id=|COMMON_WORK_SUITABILITY_Handcraft|/> trait.
fields.DESC_RECIPE_FACTORY_HARD_01:
Produces faster than <mapObjectName id=|WorkBench|/>.
Requires Pal with <uiCommon id=|COMMON_WORK_SUITABILITY_Handcraft|/> trait.
fields.DESC_RECIPE_FACTORY_HARD_02:
Needs electricity but produces items at a faster pace.
Requires Pal with <uiCommon id=|COMMON_WORK_SUITABILITY_Handcraft|/> trait.
fields.DESC_RECIPE_FACTORY_HARD_03:
Needs electricity but produces items at an even faster pace.
Requires Pal with <uiCommon id=|COMMON_WORK_SUITABILITY_Handcraft|/> trait.
fields.DESC_RECIPE_ITEM_CHEST_01:
Used to store items. Place at a base and Pals with
<uiCommon id=|COMMON_WORK_SUITABILITY_Transport|/> suitability will automatically carry items to it.
fields.DESC_RECIPE_ITEM_CHEST_02:
Can be used to store more items. Pals with
<uiCommon id=|COMMON_WORK_SUITABILITY_Transport|/> suitability will automatically carry items to it.
fields.DESC_RECIPE_ITEM_CHEST_03:
Can be used to store even more items. Pals with
<uiCommon id=|COMMON_WORK_SUITABILITY_Transport|/> suitability will automatically carry items to it.
fields.DESC_RECIPE_PLAYER_BED_02:
Human bed. Sleeping restores Health.
Sleep at night and time will pass until morning.
Cannot sleep unless built under a roof.
fields.DESC_RECIPE_PLAYER_BED_03:
Soft bed with improved restorative capabilities.
Cannot sleep unless built under a roof.
fields.DESC_RECIPE_ELECTRIX_GENERATOR:
Electric Pals at the base can now store electricity,
allowing the use of electric facilities.
fields.DESC_RECIPE_HatchingPalEgg: Place a Pal Egg inside to incubate it.
fields.DESC_RECIPE_StationDeforest2:
Can produce wood at a base.
Requires Pal with <uiCommon id=|COMMON_WORK_SUITABILITY_Deforest|/> suitability.
fields.DESC_RECIPE_WORKBENCH_SKILLUNLOCK:
Produces items that allow Pals
to use Partner Skills.
fields.DESC_RECIPE_PalFoodBox:
Place food here, and Pals at the base
will eat from it.
fields.DESC_RECIPE_Shield_01:
Strange shield made with Paldium technology.
It automatically repair itself after not taking damage for a while.
fields.DESC_RECIPE_Shield_02:
Strange shield made with Paldium technology.
The new model has been improved, enhancing its defense.
Can be made at <mapObjectName id=|Factory_Hard_01|/>.
fields.DESC_RECIPE_Shield_03:
Strange shield made with Paldium technology.
Modifications have enhanced its effectiveness even further.
Can be made at <mapObjectName id=|Factory_Hard_02|/>.
fields.DESC_RECIPE_Shield_04:
Strange shield made with Paldium technology.
Through repeated testing, the highest quality has been achieved.
Can be made at <mapObjectName id=|Factory_Hard_03|/>.
fields.DESC_RECIPE_Shield_Ultra:
Strange shield made with Paldium technology.
As a result of further experiments, ultimate quality has been achieved.
Can be made at <mapObjectName id=|Factory_Hard_03|/>.
fields.DESC_RECIPE_Battle_Glider_Grade_01:
A glider for soaring through the air.
Cheaply made, it isn't very fast.
fields.DESC_RECIPE_Battle_Glider_Grade_02:
A glider for soaring through the air.
A mass produced commercial model, it’s decently fast.
Can be made at <mapObjectName id=|Factory_Hard_01|/>.
fields.DESC_RECIPE_Battle_Glider_Grade_03:
A glider for soaring through the air.
With its capabilities improved, it can soar at high speed.
Can be made at <mapObjectName id=|Factory_Hard_02|/>
fields.DESC_RECIPE_Battle_Glider_Grade_04:
A glider for soaring through the air.
Its performance has been further improved, with increased speed and lift.
Can be made at <mapObjectName id=|Factory_Hard_03|/>.
fields.DESC_RECIPE_RepairKit:
Used for repairing destroyed structures.
Use on destroyed structures.
fields.DESC_RECIPE_Berries_plantation:
Can produce berries at a base. Requires Pal with
<uiCommon id=|COMMON_WORK_TYPE_Seeding|/>, <uiCommon id=|COMMON_WORK_TYPE_Watering|/>, and <uiCommon id=|COMMON_WORK_TYPE_CollectResourcePickable|/> suitabilities.
fields.DESC_RECIPE_wheat_plantation:
Use it to grow ingredients for <itemName id=|Pan|/>.
Requires Pal with <uiCommon id=|COMMON_WORK_TYPE_Seeding|/>, <uiCommon id=|COMMON_WORK_TYPE_Watering|/>, and <uiCommon id=|COMMON_WORK_TYPE_CollectResourcePickable|/> suitabilities.
fields.DESC_RECIPE_tomato_plantation:
Farm for producing tomatoes.
Requires Pal with <uiCommon id=|COMMON_WORK_TYPE_Seeding|/>, <uiCommon id=|COMMON_WORK_TYPE_Watering|/>, and <uiCommon id=|COMMON_WORK_TYPE_CollectResourcePickable|/> suitabilities.
fields.DESC_RECIPE_Lettuce_plantation:
Farm for producing lettuce.
Requires Pal with <uiCommon id=|COMMON_WORK_TYPE_Seeding|/>, <uiCommon id=|COMMON_WORK_TYPE_Watering|/>, and <uiCommon id=|COMMON_WORK_TYPE_CollectResourcePickable|/> suitabilities.
fields.DESC_RECIPE_Wooden_foundation: Infrastructure for a base. Low durability.
fields.DESC_RECIPE_Wooden_wall: Protects supplies from attack. Low durability.
fields.DESC_RECIPE_Wooden_roof: Cannot sleep at a bed unless built under a roof.
fields.DESC_RECIPE_Wooden_stair: Infrastructure for a base. Low durability.
fields.DESC_RECIPE_Stone_foundation: Foundation with improved durability. Cannot be burned.
fields.DESC_RECIPE_Stone_wall: Defensive wall with improved durability. Cannot be burned.
fields.DESC_RECIPE_Stone_roof: Roof with improved durability. Cannot be burned.
fields.DESC_RECIPE_Stone_stair: Stairs with improved durability. Cannot be burned.
fields.DESC_RECIPE_Metal_foundation: Foundation with high durability. Cannot be burned.
fields.DESC_RECIPE_Metal_wall: Defensive wall with high durability. Cannot be burned.
fields.DESC_RECIPE_Metal_roof: Roof with high durability. Cannot be burned.
fields.DESC_RECIPE_Metal_stair: Stairs with improved durability. Cannot be burned.
fields.DESC_RECIPE_MAKESHIFTHANDGUN:
A handgun created from spare parts.
Relatively well suited for close quarters combat, but can only fire one shot before needing to reload.
Crafted at <mapObjectName id=|WeaponFactory_Dirty_01|/>.
fields.DESC_RECIPE_HANDGUNBULLET:
Ammo for <itemName id=|HandGun_Default|/> and other similar weapons.
Requires <mapObjectName id=|WeaponFactory_Dirty_01|/> to craft.
fields.DESC_RECIPE_RoughBullet:
Ammo for <itemName id=|Musket|/>, <itemName id=|MakeshiftHandgun|/> and other similar weapons.
Requires <mapObjectName id=|WeaponFactory_Dirty_01|/> to craft.
fields.DESC_RECIPE_MachingunBullet:
Ammo for <itemName id=|Machingun|/> and other similar weapons.
Requires <mapObjectName id=|WeaponFactory_Dirty_01|/> to craft.
fields.DESC_RECIPE_AssaultRifleBullet:
Ammo for <itemName id=|AssaultRifle_Default1|/> and other similar weapons.
Requires <mapObjectName id=|WeaponFactory_Dirty_02|/> to craft.
fields.DESC_RECIPE_MagnumBullet:
Ammo for <itemName id=|Magnum|/> and other similar weapons.
Requires <mapObjectName id=|WeaponFactory_Dirty_01|/> to craft.
fields.DESC_RECIPE_Spa: Pals recover SAN while in a <mapObjectName id=|Spa|/>.
fields.DESC_RECIPE_Spa2: Pals recover plenty of SAN while in the hot spring.
fields.DESC_RECIPE_Heater: Warms the nearby area and protects against the cold.
fields.DESC_RECIPE_ElectricHeater:
Warms the nearby area and protects against the cold.
Improved range and heating capabilities.
fields.DESC_RECIPE_Cooler: Cools the nearby area and protects against the heat.
fields.DESC_RECIPE_ElectricCooler:
Cools the nearby area and protects against the heat.
Improved range and cooling capabilities.
fields.DESC_RECIPE_Torch: Place it at a base to light the surrounding area.
fields.DESC_RECIPE_WallTorch: Place it on a wall to light the surrounding area.
fields.DESC_RECIPE_Lamp: Lights up dark areas at a base.
fields.DESC_RECIPE_CeilingLamp: Lights up dark areas below at a base.
fields.DESC_RECIPE_LargeLamp: Lights up large areas at a base.
fields.DESC_RECIPE_LargeCeilingLamp: Lights up large areas below at a base.
fields.DESC_RECIPE_PALBOX:
Facility for storing captured Pals.
Pals inside gradually recover Health.
The area around this structure will become your base.
fields.DESC_RECIPE_HandTorch:
Lights up dark areas and keeps you warm.
Can also be used for close range combat in a pinch.
Crafts <itemName id=|Torch|/> at<mapObjectName id=|WorkBench|/>.
fields.DESC_RECIPE_BuildableGoddessStatue: Make offerings to enhance the stats of the Player and their Pals.
fields.DESC_RECIPE_Wooden_Houseset:
Set for building bases using wood.
Allows building of wooden foundations, walls, ceilings, stairs and other things necessary for shelters.
fields.DESC_RECIPE_Stone_Houseset:
Set for building bases using stone.
Allows building of stone foundations, walls, ceilings, stairs and other things necessary for shelters.
fields.DESC_RECIPE_Metal_Houseset:
Set for building bases using metal.
Allows building of metal foundations, walls, ceilings, stairs and other things necessary for shelters.
fields.DESC_RECIPE_DisplayCharacter:
Container for observing captured Pals.
Pals inside cannot participate in battle or production, but they do not become hungry.
fields.DESC_RECIPE_DefenseWall: Large defensive wall that protects from enemy invasions.
fields.DESC_RECIPE_BaseCampBattleDirector:
Bell that sets the alert status for Pals on base.
Change Pal behavior to either attack invading enemies or focus entirely on work whenever you like.
fields.DESC_RECIPE_Spear:
Useful for close-range combat.
Its length allows you to stand further away when attacking.
fields.DESC_RECIPE_Spear_2:
Useful for close-range combat.
The metal tip enhances its striking power.
Requires <mapObjectName id=|Factory_Hard_01|/> to craft.
fields.DESC_RECIPE_Spear_3:
Useful for close-range combat.
The high-quality metal tip enhances its striking power.
Requires <mapObjectName id=|Factory_Hard_02|/> to craft.
fields.DESC_RECIPE_Crusher:
Facility for breaking down <itemName id=|Stone|/> and <itemName id=|Wood|/> to exchange them for other materials.
Requires Pal with the Watering suitability to spin the water turbine.
fields.DESC_RECIPE_WoodCrusher:
<mapObjectName id=|WoodCrusher|/> can be constructed.
You can extract <itemName id=|Fiber|/> by cutting <itemName id=|Wood|/>.
fields.DESC_RECIPE_FlourMill:
Facility for milling <itemName id=|Wheat|/> to produce <itemName id=|Flour|/>. 
Requires Pal with the Watering suitability to spin the water turbine.
fields.DESC_RECIPE_Trap_MineElecShock:
Electrocutes those who step on it.
Electrocuted Pals are easier to capture.
fields.DESC_RECIPE_Trap_MineFreeze:
Freezes those who step on it.
Frozen Pals are easier to capture.
fields.DESC_RECIPE_Trap_LegHold:
Immobilizes those who step on it.
Only effective on small Pals or humans.
fields.DESC_RECIPE_Trap_LegHold_Big:
Immobilizes those who step on it.
Only effective on large Pals.

fields.DESC_RECIPE_BreedFarm:
Assign a male and a female Pal to produce eggs.
<itemName id=|Cake|/> is required for breeding.
fields.DESC_RECIPE_Wooden_DoorWall: Can be locked with a passcode.
fields.DESC_RECIPE_Stone_DoorWall: Can be locked with a passcode.
fields.DESC_RECIPE_Metal_DoorWall: Can be locked with a passcode.
fields.DESC_RECIPE_Musket:
Simple, old fashioned gun. 
Fires a single, powerful shot at the expense of a long reload time.
Requires <mapObjectName id=|WeaponFactory_Dirty_01|/> to craft.
fields.DESC_RECIPE_MeatCutterKnife:
Knife for butchering Pals.
When equipped, the Pet command becomes Butcher.
Butchered Pals will be gone for good.
fields.DESC_RECIPE_CoolerBox:
A small food storage.
When you assign an Ice Pal to it, the food inside becomes less likely to spoil.
fields.DESC_RECIPE_Refrigerator:
A large food storage.
When you assign an Ice Pal to it, the food inside becomes less likely to spoil.
fields.DESC_RECIPE_BaseCampWorkHard:
You can command your Pals to work on various things inside a base.
Try not to overwork them!
fields.DESC_RECIPE_MonsterFarm:
Ranch for raising sheep and fowl-like Pals.
Assign Pals with the appropriate work suitability to the ranch
to automatically produce items.
fields.DESC_RECIPE_Wood_Gate: Wooden gate large enough for big Pals to pass through.
fields.DESC_RECIPE_Stone_Gate: Stone gate large enough for big Pals to pass through.
fields.DESC_RECIPE_Metal_Gate: Metal gate large enough for big Pals to pass through.
fields.DESC_RECIPE_Trap_Noose:
Catches Pals that pass through.
Only effective on small Pals and humans.
fields.DESC_RECIPE_DamagedScarecrow: Training dummy shaped like a Pengullet.
fields.DESC_RECIPE_DefenseWall_Wood:
Massive defensive wall to prevent enemy intrusions.
Made from wood, it breaks easily.
fields.DESC_RECIPE_DefenseWall_Metal:
Massive defensive wall to prevent enemy intrusions.
Made from metal, it is extremely durable.
fields.DESC_RECIPE_FurnitureSet_1:
Decorative furniture set.
Place furniture in your living space and enjoy life with your Pals.
fields.DESC_RECIPE_FurnitureSet_2:
Set of wooden cabinets that look at home in a tavern.
Can store items.
fields.DESC_RECIPE_FurnitureSet_3:

Street lamp set to provide illumination.

fields.DESC_RECIPE_FurnitureSet_28:

fields.DESC_RECIPE_FurnitureSet_29:

fields.DESC_RECIPE_FurnitureSet_32:
Decorative furniture set.

fields.DESC_RECIPE_DecalGunSet:
Decal gun set.
Allows crafting of a strange gun that paints a Pal decal where it is fired.
Required ammo also becomes craftable.
fields.DESC_RECIPE_SPHERE7:
An item that captures Pals when thrown.
Almost no Pals can escape its flawless design.
Requires <mapObjectName id=|SphereFactory_Black_03|/> to craft.
fields.DESC_RECIPE_ARMOR6:
Armor developed by pushing the edge of technology.
Boasts unparalleled defense.
Requires <mapObjectName id=|Factory_Hard_03|/> to craft.
fields.DESC_RECIPE_GrenadeLauncher:
Fires grenades that cause wide-ranging explosions.
Useful when dealing with a large number of enemies.
Crafted at <mapObjectName id=|WeaponFactory_Dirty_03|/>
fields.DESC_RECIPE_GuidedMissileLauncher:
Fires missiles that automatically track and pursue enemies.
Missiles explode upon impact, causing damage over a wide area.
fields.DESC_RECIPE_HELMET6:
Helmet made of <itemName id=|Plastic|/>.
In addition to enhanced defense capabilities, its weight was also reduced.
Requires <mapObjectName id=|Factory_Hard_03|/> to craft.
fields.DESC_RECIPE_LaserRifle:
A weapon that fires high-energy lasers.
It has impressive firepower and is easy to handle.
Crafted at <mapObjectName id=|WeaponFactory_Dirty_03|/>.
fields.DESC_RECIPE_Flamethrower:
<itemName id=|Flamethrower|/> that fires long-range flame.
Can set the enemy on fire.
Crafted at <mapObjectName id=|WeaponFactory_Dirty_03|/>.
fields.DESC_RECIPE_ARMOR6_Heat:
Improved <itemName id=|PlasticArmor|/>.
Boasts high heat resistance.
Requires <mapObjectName id=|Factory_Hard_03|/> to craft.
fields.DESC_RECIPE_ARMOR6_Cold:
Improved <itemName id=|PlasticArmor|/>.
Useful for surviving in cold climates.
Requires <mapObjectName id=|Factory_Hard_03|/> to craft.
fields.DESC_RECIPE_ARMOR6_Weight:
Improved <itemName id=|PlasticArmor|/>.
Increases carrying capacity.
Requires <mapObjectName id=|Factory_Hard_03|/> to craft.
fields.DESC_RECIPE_GatlingGun:
A Gatling Gun capable of rapid fire. 
Mows down enemies with suppressive fire.
Crafted at <mapObjectName id=|WeaponFactory_Dirty_03|/>.
fields.DESC_RECIPE_Glass_Houseset:
Set for building bases using glass.
Allows building of glass foundations, walls, ceilings, stairs and other things necessary for shelters.
fields.DESC_RECIPE_Launcher_Meteor:
A phenomenal weapon that fires a meteor.
Upon striking its target, it creates an explosion similar to a meteorite impact.
Crafted at <mapObjectName id=|WeaponFactory_Dirty_02|/>.
fields.DESC_RECIPE_JapaneseStyle_Houseset:
Set for building bases using Japanese-style architecture.
Allows building of Japanese-style foundations, walls, ceilings, stairs and other things necessary for shelters.
fields.DESC_RECIPE_JapaneseStyle_FurnitureSet:
Japanese-style decorative furniture set.
Transform your base into a traditional Japanese haven.
fields.DESC_RECIPE_SF_Houseset:
Set for building bases using futuristic architecture. 
Allows building of futuristic foundations, walls, ceilings, stairs and other things necessary for shelters.
fields.DESC_RECIPE_FishingSet1:
Beginner-friendly fishing rod and bait set. 
Once you craft both, you'll be able to fish for Pals near bodies of water.
fields.DESC_RECIPE_FishingSet2:
Intermediate fishing rod and bait set. 
Once you craft both, you'll be able to fish for Pals near bodies of water.
fields.DESC_RECIPE_FishingSet3:

Once you craft both, you'll be able to fish for Pals near bodies of water.
